measurement_scope: CWRU laboratory drive-end bearing housing vibration; not direct measurements inside a bearing.

label_mapping.purpose: evaluation labels and potential future diagnostic output; never sensor evidence
label_mapping.status: proposed contextual association; not owl:sameAs or confirmed asset diagnosis
limitations: The existing damaged-bearing concept has a Timken source context.
CWRU seeded defects do not automatically equal functional failure or establish a natural root cause.
All current records have defects; binary damage probabilities cannot be validated with this subset.

bayesian_design_proposal.purpose: Estimate bearing condition from vibration, then retrieve related ontology claims.
bayesian_design_proposal.status: normal data missing; conditional feature independence not justified; probabilities not deployed
bayesian_design_proposal.integration: Separate measurement model. Do not populate the current binary motor_bn.json with these class probabilities.

unsupported_targets.reason: Defect is not established functional failure.
No lubrication-condition observation or cause labels.
No alignment observation or misalignment labels.

no_automatic_recommendation: Retrieve source-specific context only; bearing-damage classification does not authorize repair actions.
